summary: Fixed the concurrent idempotency lost-ack race in the OTLP receiver: replaced reserve/release (which treated in-flight as persisted) with a wait/state protocol (acquire/commit/abort over keyState{done,committed}). A concurrent duplicate now waits for the leader's outcome: duplicate only if the leader COMMITTED; if the leader ABORTED (sink failed), exactly one waiter re-leads and retries. Guarantees no acknowledged loss, exactly one eventual persist, and correct counters. Restored top-of-loop ctx check (canceled->408, no persist). All 13 package tests PASS (incl. the pre-existing concurrent race tests that previously deadlocked the old code, and 2 new gate-sink regressions). gofmt/build/vet/diff clean.
